theater: 摩拉瓦河谷與潘諾尼亞邊區

battle.name: 法蘭克-摩拉維亞戰爭
battle.theater: 摩拉瓦河谷與潘諾尼亞邊區
battle.brief: 882年，潘諾尼亞邊區因首領恩格爾沙爾克叛變而開戰，摩拉維亞親王斯瓦托普爾克越境支援叛者，卡林西亞公爵阿努爾夫集結法蘭克與巴伐利亞軍反攻摩拉瓦河谷。這場戰爭沒有決定性會戰，以884年圖倫議和收場，中間的攻守之處，正是卡林西亞守軍與摩拉維亞攻城方靠弩砲與弩箭對峙的堡寨戰線。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰方大致分成兩大陣營，此外還有被捲入的附庸首領與教會力量。東方法蘭克一方由皇帝查理胖子主持，名義上以潘諾尼亞邊區總督 Aribo 為前線指揮，但真正主導 882 年出兵的是卡林西亞公爵阿努爾夫。他出身不合法，卻在帝國東方握有實力，接受下潘諾尼亞首領恩格爾沙爾克二世與威爾赫爾米納一族的效忠，此舉同時得罪叔父皇帝，兩人之間的信任就此斷裂。軍隊主力由巴伐利亞、法蘭克、薩克森與阿勒曼尼諸郡徵召，邊區守軍與潘諾尼亞、卡林西亞的民兵隨行，水軍則沿多瑙河提供運輸。摩拉維亞一方以大摩拉維亞親王斯瓦托普爾克一世為核心，國家是結構鬆散的親王聯邦，核心在摩拉瓦河中游，勢力範圍伸入今捷克、斯洛伐克、波蘭、匈牙利與奧地利一帶。潘諾尼亞的斯拉夫人是這場戰爭裡的內應方，因此戰事也把薩爾斯堡的拉丁傳教團、摩拉維亞的斯拉夫語禮儀一派與教廷同時捲入糾紛。匈牙利人在此時尚未成為主角，只在十年後的邊境衝突中露面。
countriesEn: The opposing sides fell into two broad blocs, with client lords and ecclesiastical interests dragged along with them. The East Frankish side operated in the name of Emperor Charles the Fat, grandson of Charlemagne and son of Louis the German; on paper the frontier was held by the March of Pannonia under Margrave Aribo, but the man who actually shaped the campaign of 882 was Arnulf, Duke of Carinthia. An illegitimate son of Carloman of Bavaria and Liutswind, Arnulf nonetheless held real power in the eastern empire, and he chose to accept the homage of Engelschalk II of Pannonia and of the Wilhelminer family. That step cost him the trust of his uncle the emperor, and the two were never reconciled. His forces were levied from the counties of Bavaria, Franconia, Saxony and the Alamanni, with the garrisons of the march and Pannonian and Carinthian contingents attached, while river crews on the Danube supplied the transport. The other side was the principality of Svatopluk I of Great Moravia, a loosely knit confederation of Slavic principalities whose core lay in the middle Morava valley and whose reach extended into parts of present-day Czechia, Slovakia, Poland, Hungary and Austria. The Slavic lords of Lower Pannonia were the internal allies who made the rising into a general war, and through them the quarrel between the Latin mission of Salzburg, the Slavonic liturgy of Moravia and the papacy was pulled into the same entanglement. The Hungarians played no part in these years and only appear on the frontier a decade later.
people: 斯瓦托普爾克一世（約 840 至 894 年）是大摩拉維亞的頂峰君主。他早年在尼特拉公國起家，870 年廢黜叔父拉斯蒂斯拉夫並向法蘭克告密，隨後因摩拉維亞起義重新獲得自由，874 年在福爾茨海姆議和時向東方法蘭克納貢。他同時經營教廷關係，880 年受教宗思蒂芬五世保護，885 年教宗在信中稱他為「王」。882 年他趁潘諾尼亞貴族叛亂越境出兵，與法努爾夫支持的法蘭克一方正面相撞，戰後仍保住摩拉維亞的完整，是這場戰爭裡唯一沒有被削弱的一方。阿努爾夫（約 850 至 899 年）是卡爾洛曼與留茨溫德的私生子，879 年受封卡林西亞公爵，881 年取得潘諾尼亞，882 年公開站在恩格爾沙爾克一邊，與查理胖子交惡。史家認為這場戰爭直接毀掉了他繼承帝位的指望，反而促成 887 年他在特里布爾廢黜叔父、自立為東法蘭克國王。潘諾尼亞邊區總督 Aribo 主持邊防與徵召，891 年再奉命出使摩拉維亞。摩拉維亞方面的將領多出自親王血脈與地方貴族，名字在編年史中留下有限，較常被提及的是斯瓦托普爾克的兄弟與諸子。
peopleEn: Svatopluk I (c. 840 to 894) was Great Moravia's high-water prince. He rose from the principality of Nitra, deposed his uncle Rastislav in 870 and informed the Franks against him, was freed again by the Moravian rising, and accepted tribute to East Francia under the peace concluded at Forchheim in 874. At the same time he cultivated the papacy: in 880 he was placed under the protection of Pope Stephen V, and in 885 a papal letter addressed him as king. In 882 he crossed the frontier in support of the Pannonian rising and collided with the Frankish side backed by Arnulf, and he still emerged from the war with Moravia intact, the only party not weakened by it. Arnulf (c. 850 to 899) was the illegitimate son of Carloman and Liutswind, was granted the Duchy of Carinthia in 879 and Pannonia in 881, and in 882 openly took the side of Engelschalk, breaking with Charles the Fat. Many historians read this war as the thing that destroyed his hopes of inheriting the empire, and it was the very break that let him depose his uncle at the diet of Tribur in 887 and proclaim himself king of East Francia. Margrave Aribo directed the frontier and the levies and was sent to Moravia once more as an envoy in 891. Moravian commanders came largely from the prince's own kindred and the local nobility, and the annals preserve only a few of their names, most often the brothers and sons of Svatopluk.
kits: 卡面上的兵器是羅馬扭力弩砲（Scorpio，約公元前 50 年）：以扭力絞盤蓄能、單人上弦，一發射出一支鐵芯重箭（spina），穿甲力遠勝同期常見的抛射武器，羅馬人用它拆掉希臘城牆，也用它終結了城邦體系。但到 882 年，羅馬的國家軍械體系早已解體，完整的攻城弩砲不再有常備編制，設計本身卻以兩種形式存活：小型化的手用十字弩，以及可上架、可移動的擲箭機。卡林西亞與潘諾尼亞邊區守軍、摩拉維亞攻城一方能用的投射兵器，主要就是這一族的後繼者；拉丁文獻裡 arcuballista 指手用十字弩，ballista 指可移動弩砲，這種分工在九世紀的莊園與教會文書中仍可見。摩拉維亞堡寨多為木柵加土堤的結構，壕溝、削尖木樁與木製望樓迫使攻城方先填壕，再以雲梯與撞槌貼近，弩砲唯一的任務就是在壕溝彼端壓制牆頭，攔住守軍的矢石與滾木。編年史沒有逐件記錄 882 至 884 年所用的機械，這裡的對應是依同時期中歐攻城戰的一般做法所作的推斷。戰場上另有一整套常用裝備：法蘭克重騎的長矛、破甲錘與鎖子甲，圓盾與橡木大盾的組合，標槍、投石索與獵弓，以及按季度發給邊區守軍的弩與箭；摩拉維亞與潘諾尼亞守軍則靠木製胸牆、地形與冬季泥濘作戰。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman torsion bolt-thrower, the Scorpio, of about 50 BC: a machine wound by twisted skeins, cocked by a single crewman, firing one heavy iron-shanked bolt, the spina, with armour-piercing force well beyond the missile weapons of its own day. The Romans used it to break Greek city walls and to end the Greek system of city states. By 882, however, the Roman state arsenal had long since dissolved and no complete siege bolt-thrower survived as an institutional weapon; the design itself lived on in two forms, the small hand crossbow and the larger mounted and movable bolt-thrower. Those are the kinds of missile engines the garrisons of Carinthia and the Pannonian march, and the Moravian besiegers, actually had to hand. In Latin sources arcuballista means the hand crossbow and ballista the movable artillery piece, a distinction still visible in ninth-century estate and ecclesiastical documents. Moravian strongholds were timber palisades on earthen ramparts, and their ditches, sharpened stakes and wooden watchtowers forced the attacker to fill the ditch first and then bring up ladders and rams; the one job of the bolt-thrower was to sweep the parapet from across the ditch and silence the sling-stones and logs rolled down by the defenders. The annals do not itemise the machines used in 882 to 884, so the identification here is an inference drawn from the ordinary practice of Central European siege warfare in the period. The rest of the field equipment is standard: lances, war hammers and mail for Frankish heavy cavalry, round shields and large oak shields, javelins, slings and hunting bows, and the crossbows and bolts issued quarterly to the frontier garrisons; the Moravian and Pannonian garrisons fought from timber breastworks, from the terrain and from winter mud.
tactics: 882 年的開局並非正面會戰，而是摩拉維亞軍越境支援潘諾尼亞叛軍的縱深突擊：斯瓦托普爾克在法蘭克援軍尚未集結前先掃蕩邊區，試圖用快速機動把對手拖入消耗，再在選定時機投入優勢兵力。邊區與卡林西亞的守軍因此多線應戰，供養依靠河道與運河網，給養船隊沿多瑙河東下，成為遠征的動脈；水運而非陸路决定了這支軍隊能走多遠。九世紀法蘭克的野戰隊仍以徵召兵與邊軍混合編成，重騎居中衝鋒，步兵在兩翼與中央結陣，射手與投石手在前列放箭，弩手在後方以直射火力覆蓋接近路線；戰線一旦拉開，隊形便容易散亂。摩拉維亞方面的戰術更倚重堡寨與河谷地形：以木牆、壕溝與望樓構成防禦，攻城時靠填壕小徑、盾牆與雲梯接近，守方從頭頂拋擲石塊、箭矢與沸水，最後才在城門與缺口處短兵相接。雙方都懂得把田地與牧場算進戰爭，摩拉維亞多次以焚燒村莊、荒廢田畝拖延法蘭克遠征軍，這套手段日後對付匈牙利人時再度被摩拉維亞人使用，成為對付輕騎游牧者的標準應對。
tacticsEn: The war of 882 did not open with a set-piece battle. It opened with a deep incursion by Moravian troops into Pannonia in support of the Pannonian rebels: before the Frankish relief could assemble, Svatopluk swept the march, hoping to wear the enemy down with rapid movement and then commit his superior force at a moment of his choosing. The garrisons of the march and of Carinthia were therefore forced to fight on several fronts at once, and supply ran on the river and canal network, with supply boats descending the Danube; water, not road, decided how far the expedition could reach. A Frankish field army in the ninth century was still a mix of levy and frontier troops: heavy cavalry in the centre, infantry closed up on the flanks and in the middle, archers and slingers opening the line, crossbowmen covering the approach with direct fire from behind. Once the line was stretched, the formation easily came apart. Moravian tactics leaned harder on strongholds and on river-valley terrain: defences of timber wall, ditch and watchtower; sieges fought with causeways across the ditch, shields and ladders; the defenders hurling stones, arrows and boiling water from the parapet before the fight came down to close quarters at the gate and the breaches. Both sides understood that fields and pasture belonged to the war, and Moravia repeatedly burned villages and let the fields run wild to slow the Frankish column, the same method the Moravians would later turn against the Hungarians and standard practice for meeting light nomadic cavalry.
data: 這場戰爭可核的數字不多，編年史多記劫掠與焚燄而不記兵力。可確定的年份是：882 年開打，兩方在 884 年於奧地利下城圖倫議和；另一份較晚的記載把阿努爾夫與斯瓦托普爾克的和解記為 885 年，兩說並存，前後只差一年，說明戰事拖了兩三個戰季。戰區的空間尺度可以估算：潘諾尼亞邊防由巴伐利亞的雷根斯堡一帶沿多瑙河東伸到拉巴河與多瑙河匯流處，再折向摩拉瓦河谷，蜿蜒約數百公里；遠征隊從巴伐利亞出發，沿多瑙河東下，經帕紹渡河，再溯摩拉瓦河谷向東推進至尼特拉與大摩拉維亞核心地帶，全程大致數百公里，正好是一支混合徵召兵在九世紀行軍速度下需要一到兩個月的路程。摩拉維亞方面的疆域在斯瓦托普爾克一世治下達到頂峰，涵蓋今捷克、斯洛伐克、波蘭、匈牙利、奧地利、羅馬尼亞、南斯拉夫、克羅地亞、塞爾維亞、烏克蘭與斯洛維尼亞的部分土地，規模遠大於它所對付的法蘭克邊區。傷亡數字無從查證：史料只說摩拉維亞軍在潘諾尼亞以火與劍大批殺戮、焚燄，法蘭克方面的損失則完全沒有數字。唯一帶日期的後續事件是 891 年阿努爾夫的第二次入侵，他先在薩瓦河會見斯拉夫首領布拉斯拉夫，再集合法蘭克人、巴伐利亞人與阿勒曼尼人，並招募匈牙利人同行；同年另記有摩拉瓦河一役失利與退兵的記載，兵力與損耗一樣沒有留下。外交方面可留日期的有 867 至 868 年教宗哈德良二世批准古斯拉夫語禮儀、873 至 874 年福爾茨海姆和約要求摩拉維亞納貢，以及 880 年教廷正式保護斯瓦托普爾克。882 年開戰的具體月份在編年史中未見記載，卡面暫取四月。
dataEn: The war leaves few verifiable figures, because the annals record burnings and slaughter rather than armies. The years that can be fixed are 882 for the outbreak and 884 for the settlement at Tulln in Lower Austria; a later source puts the reconciliation between Arnulf and Svatopluk in 885. Both readings stand, and the single year between them suggests the fighting dragged on for two or three campaigning seasons. The size of the theatre can be estimated rather than measured. The Pannonian defensive line ran from the Regensburg area in Bavaria down the Danube to the confluence of the Rába and the Danube, then turned east into the Morava valley, a frontier several hundred kilometres long. The expedition set out from Bavaria, descended the Danube, crossed at Passau and then worked up the Morava valley toward Nitra and the heartland of Great Moravia; the whole march was of the order of several hundred kilometres, which for a mixed levy in the ninth century means one to two months of movement. Under Svatopluk I the Moravian state reached its greatest extent, covering parts of what are now the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Hungary, Austria, Romania, Yugoslavia, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine and Slovenia, and it was far larger than the Frankish march it fought. Casualty figures cannot be recovered: the sources say only that the Moravian host killed and burned much in Pannonia, while Frankish losses are not recorded at all. The only later event carrying a date is Arnulf's second invasion of 891, when he first met the Slavic lord Braslav on the Sava, then gathered Franconians, Bavarians and Alamanni and took Hungarian auxiliaries with him; a defeat and a withdrawal in the Morava valley are recorded in the same year, but neither the numbers of men nor of losses survive. On the diplomatic side the datable anchors are the approval of the Slavonic rite by Pope Adrian II in 867 and 868, the treaty of Forchheim in 873 and 874 by which Moravia agreed to pay tribute, and the formal extension of papal protection to Svatopluk in 880. The month of the outbreak in 882 is not recorded in the annals; the card entry notes April by convention rather than by evidence.
cause: 導火線在 882 年由潘諾尼亞爆發。帝國邊區總督 Aribo 對下潘諾尼亞的斯拉夫首領恩格爾沙爾克二世加強控制，恩格爾沙爾克起兵反叛，史家稱之為威爾赫爾米納戰爭。卡林西亞公爵阿努爾夫在帝國東方的地盤與邊區相連，他選擇支持叛者，收取恩格爾沙爾克與其兄弟的效忠，此舉同時惹怒叔父皇帝，兩人之間的信任就此斷裂。深層原因是摩拉維亞的實力膨脹：斯瓦托普爾克一世在 870 年代把大摩拉維亞推到頂峰，尼特拉、波希米亞與潘諾尼亞一帶都被納入或受到威脅，帝國東方無法接受一個在邊境上比自己更強大的斯拉夫政權。宗教層面的裂痕同樣真實：863 年西里爾與美多菲抵達摩拉維亞傳教，867 至 868 年間教廷批准古斯拉夫語禮儀，薩爾斯堡的拉丁傳教團與摩拉維亞的斯拉夫語教會在教區界線上互相排斥；摩拉維亞同時在教廷與帝國之間兩面下注，880 年受教宗保護、885 年被稱為「王」，這些做法讓帝國教士視之為背叛。於是三條線索疊在一起：邊區的叛亂、王室對叛亂者的支持、摩拉維亞的越境進攻，最終把原本可以分開處理的問題推成一場全面戰爭。
causeEn: The spark was struck in Pannonia in 882. Margrave Aribo tightened his grip on Engelschalk II, the Slavic ruler of Lower Pannonia; Engelschalk rose in revolt, and the episode is what historians call the Wilhelminer war. Arnulf, Duke of Carinthia, whose own lands in the eastern empire adjoined the march, backed the rebels and took the homage of Engelschalk and his brother. That step also offended his uncle the emperor, and the trust between the two was broken. The deeper cause was the growing weight of Moravia: in the 870s Svatopluk I carried Great Moravia to its height, taking in or threatening Nitra, Bohemia and Pannonia, and the eastern empire could not accept a Slavic power on its frontier stronger than itself. The religious fault line was equally real. Cyril and Methodius reached Moravia as missionaries in 863, the Slavonic rite was approved by the papacy in 867 and 868, and the Latin mission of Salzburg and the Slavonic church of Moravia excluded each other from the same sees. Moravia played both sides, seeking the protection of the papacy in 880 and being called king by it in 885, and the imperial clergy read all of this as betrayal. Three threads therefore ran together: the revolt in the march, the royal support given to the rebels, and the Moravian incursion across the frontier, and what could have been settled in three separate ways turned into a general war.
impact: 戰爭的後果遠超出戰場。潘諾尼亞與多瑙河中游受創最重：摩拉維亞軍深入邊區，殺戮、焚燄與搶掠反覆摧毀了賦稅與屯糧的基層，編年史形容這一帶被火與劍掃過，幾年後匈牙利人之所以能在潘諾尼亞站住腳跟，很大程度上因為這段繁榮區被提前掏空。對阿努爾夫而言，這場戰爭是政治命運的轉折點：支持潘諾尼亞叛者使他與查理胖子決裂，原本的接班打算落空，卻也讓他能在 887 年特里布爾會議上以東方權貴的名義集結力量廢黜叔父，自立為東法蘭克國王，後加冕皇帝，成為卡洛林王朝男系最後一位皇帝。對摩拉維亞而言，戰爭證明其巔峰期並非無懈可擊，並直接引發 881 年前後教會路線的分裂，886 年斯瓦托普爾克在梅多菲去世後驅逐其門徒，令古斯拉夫語禮儀在摩拉維亞中斷，摩拉維亞與拜占庭式東方基督教傳統的聯繫轉冷，國家在教派上更靠近拉丁西方。另一層長遠影響是匈牙利人：891 年阿努爾夫招募匈牙利傭兵作戰，把匈牙利人帶上中歐戰場，這種軍事合作經過 895 年之後的大規模西遷，最終在 907 年前後把大摩拉維亞推入崩潰，兩國此時的爭端反而預演了十六年後的結局。
impactEn: The consequences reached well beyond the battlefield. Pannonia and the middle Danube suffered the worst: the Moravian host drove deep into the march, and killing, burning and plunder repeatedly destroyed the base of taxation and of the stored grain, so that the chronicles could say the country was swept with fire and sword. The Hungarians' ability to settle in Pannonia a few years later owed much to that prosperous zone having been hollowed out in advance. For Arnulf the war was the turning point of his political life: backing the Pannonian rebels broke him with Charles the Fat and destroyed his expectations of succeeding to the throne, yet it was precisely that which let him rally the eastern magnates at the diet of Tribur in 887, depose his uncle and proclaim himself king of East Francia before he was crowned emperor, the last male-line Carolingian to rule Italy and the empire. For Moravia the war showed that its high point was not unassailable, and it fed directly into the split in church policy: in 886, after the death of Methodius, Svatopluk expelled the disciples, so that the Slavonic liturgy was interrupted in Moravia, the ties with the Byzantine eastern Christian tradition cooled, and the state drew closer to the Latin west in matters of doctrine. A third long-term effect concerned the Hungarians. Arnulf recruited Hungarian auxiliaries in 891 and put them on a central European battlefield; that military cooperation, followed by the great westward migration after 895, was what pushed Great Moravia to its collapse around 907, and the quarrel between the two states in 882 prefigured that ending sixteen years later.
result: 882 至 884 年的戰爭以雙方的有條件妥協收場：884 年，或按另一份記載的 885 年，法蘭克與摩拉維亞的代表在奧地利下城的圖倫會面訂立和約。摩拉維亞保住領土完整與既有實力，斯瓦托普爾克仍然是摩拉維亞的君主，並且在衝突之後仍被視為忠于皇帝的一方；法蘭克一方守住了潘諾尼亞邊區的框架，恩格爾沙爾克與威爾赫爾米納派沒有被交出，阿努爾夫保留了對這批盟友的庇護。從軍事結果看，這是一場沒有決定性會戰的消耗戰：法蘭克沒有攻下摩拉維亞的核心堡寨，摩拉維亞也沒有把邊區永久奪走，多瑙河兩岸回到脆弱的均勢。真正分出勝負的是 891 年：阿努爾夫再度入侵摩拉維亞，集結法蘭克人、巴伐利亞人、阿勒曼尼人與匈牙利人，卻在行軍與作戰中落敗，被迫退回帝國，摩拉維亞安然度過並保持擴張勢頭。因此 882 至 884 年的結果是守住，而這場戰爭的長尾效應是一連串的失敗：它在帝國東方留下一道裂痕、拆散了教會陣線、也把匈牙利人推上了歷史舞臺。
resultEn: The war of 882 to 884 ended in a conditional compromise. In 884, or by another reckoning in 885, envoys of the Franks and of Moravia met at Tulln in Lower Austria and concluded a treaty. Moravia kept its territorial integrity and its existing power, Svatopluk remained prince of Moravia and was thereafter still treated as loyal to the emperor, and on the Frankish side the framework of the Pannonian march held: Engelschalk and the Wilhelminers were not handed over, and Arnulf kept the protection of those allies. Militarily the war was an attritional contest without a decisive battle. The Franks did not take the core Moravian strongholds, Moravia did not permanently hold the march, and the two banks of the Danube settled back into a fragile balance. The real verdict came in 891, when Arnulf invaded Moravia again with Franconians, Bavarians, Alamanni and Hungarians, lost his army in the field, and withdrew to the empire, while Moravia rode out the crisis and kept expanding. The outcome of 882 to 884 was thus a holding action, and the long tail of the war was a series of failures: a fissure in the eastern empire, a broken church front, and the Hungarians pushed onto the stage of central European history.
